name: RAGE engine GPU buffer: sceKernelMapNamedDirectMemory at 0x1307200000
component: Grand Theft Auto V (CUSA00419 v1.47) RenderThread, via shadPS4 MemoryManager::MapMemory
required_postconditions: the direct-memory mapping is placed at exactly the guest address the title requested
a VMA covering [0x1307200000, 0x1307220000) exists in the emulator's address space before CarveVMA runs

failure_sink.description: ASSERT_MSG(end_in_vma <= vma.size, "Mapping cannot fit inside free region") - FindVMA returns the last VMA before the reserved gap, end_in_vma exceeds vma.size, and the process aborts during GPU initialisation

extraction_limitations: The request parameters are transcribed from a log excerpt in shadps4-emu/shadPS4 issue #4157 (in_addr 0x1307200000, len 0x20000, prot 0x33, flags 0x10 MAP_FIXED, phys_addr 0xc2ec0000), not read out of the title's binary. The title chose the address; nothing here establishes why.

prot 0x33 is decoded as CPU read+write plus GPU read+write. The GPU-side permissions have no representation in this schema and are dropped - a mapping that must be visible to a GPU may carry constraints beyond what a CPU protection triple can express.
translation_layer_available is false because shadPS4 has no guest-to-host address translation on this path; that is a property of the emulator, read from its source, not declared to us.

x_campaign.quote: sceKernelMapNamedDirectMemory: in_addr = 0x1307200000, len = 0x20000, prot = 0x33 (RW + GPU RW), flags = 0x10 (MAP_FIXED), phys_addr = 0xc2ec0000, name = 'anon'
x_campaign.rationale: 0x1307200000 lies inside the Rosetta 2 GPU carveout, which the issue reports as returning ENOMEM for every MAP_FIXED attempt. The caller demands the exact address and aborts otherwise.
